name: 受缚之残影
prompt:
Create ONE square 1:1 game card illustration for 受缚之残影 (Bound Remnant Shadow). Use case: illustration-story. No border, text, watermark, logo or UI.

REFERENCE ROLES: images1/2 are PAINTING STYLE ONLY, broad opaque brush portrait and dark-coat portrait. Borrow their confident paint economy, but make output ROUGHER and much less detailed. Image3 is only Changwuyu CHARACTER IDENTITY. Do not copy its pose, white backdrop or floating fireball.

CHARACTER: Changwuyu / 常无欲, adult elegant male, silver-gray long hair in a LOW bun, two substantial long side locks, yellow eyes visible through thin ROUND spectacles, pointed elf ear. Black long CURVED-TIP wide-brim witch hat with purple underside; black high-neck long robe/cape, broad muted purple lining and subdued gold edging. ONE white feather and blue sapphire in simple gold mount at LEFT chest. Black gloved hands. No wand, sword or military hat.

UNIQUE SHOT: a tense three-quarter torso-up close framing with a slight HIGH camera angle. His torso twists away, face turns back toward viewer with alert composed yellow eyes; ONE gloved hand is close to the chest clutching a broad symbolic binding strap, the other wrist extends lower outward but is stopped by the restraint. Keep hat silhouette, face/glasses and both hands readable. Body and main shadow make a restrained diagonal across the square, no glasses-adjusting standing pose or fireball-cupping pose.

BINDING AND REMNANT MOTIF: TWO broad chalk-gray segmented chain/strap bands cut diagonally across his torso and wrists, taut and connected to cropped frame edges. Draw each as a few LARGE simple rectangular link shapes, no tiny repeating chain detail, no photoreal polished metal, no luminous runes. A single slightly OFFSET ink-dark silhouette echo of his hat/shoulder/cape appears behind him, sliding toward the opposite side yet caught by the bands; echo is only a flat incomplete dark shape, not a second detailed character or a second face. Leave gaps between the echo's broad fragments to express '残影'; main figure solid and readable. One small plain off-white diamond/lozenge seal shape at the bands' crossing acts as the locking point, no writing, no complex sigil. A few deep blue-gray cutout shapes hint at deep-sea sealing ONLY abstractly, no ocean, water, bubbles or seabed. All chains/shadow/seal appear as symbolic graphic paint shapes.

BACKGROUND: alternation of large PURE SOLID muted teal-gray, dark navy and pale cool-gray color fields, asymmetrical simple division supporting the restrained diagonal. Matte calm empty areas around the face. ABSOLUTELY no scenic environment, sky, clouds, architecture, physical prison, sea, cave or ground. No giant rune circle or overhead magic diagram. No particles or fire.

CRITICAL FINISH: a ROUGH HAND-PAINTED ANIME COLOR SKETCH, visibly loose and unfinished, not polished illustration. VERY LARGE blunt opaque strokes and long wide swipes each construct an entire cloth plane or hair lock. One base color plus ONE broad shadow turn and few uneven broad highlights per area. Plenty of quiet interiors. Preserve a few loose structural lines, broken brush endings, exposed edge gaps and overlapping paint. Hair is a handful of substantial coherent silver-gray locks with a few broad blue-gray/lavender planes, NO fine strands or scratch networks. Hat/robe are connected near-black/gray/plum masses with 3–5 large purposeful midtone strokes, no dense creases, ornaments or metallic glints. Feather one white wedge with few notches, sapphire one flat blue accent. Face unmistakably anime, simple yellow iris shapes and selected upper-lid lines, minimal nose/mouth, single calm cheek shadow; readable character and expression without realistic beauty render. Hands clearly connected, economical anatomy.
Mostly muted cool colors, localized purple and small yellow-eye/blue-gem accents. Broad grouped hard-edge light/shadow and handmade boundaries. Roughness comes from FEWER WIDER purposeful paint marks, not all-over texture, grain/canvas filters, little facet chips or dense scratch patterns. No glossy 3D, airbrush gradients, photoreal materials, cinematic lighting, neon outline, elaborate jewelry, dense detail or clutter. Face/gesture the clearest local focus, the rest coarse and calm.
direction: 粗笔手绘、纯色抽象背景、束缚与残影意象、独特分镜，不测试
